cards.front: How many days are in a week?
cards.say: How many days are in a week? Seven days.

cards.front: Name the days of the week in order
cards.back: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
cards.say: Name the days of the week in order. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.

cards.front: Which day comes after Monday?
cards.say: Which day comes after Monday? Tuesday.

cards.front: Which day comes before Friday?
cards.say: Which day comes before Friday? Thursday.

cards.front: Which day is between Tuesday and Thursday?
cards.say: Which day is between Tuesday and Thursday? Wednesday.

cards.front: Which day comes after Saturday?
cards.say: Which day comes after Saturday? Sunday.

cards.front: The weekend has which two days?
cards.say: The weekend has which two days? Saturday and Sunday.

cards.front: Today is Wednesday. What day is tomorrow?
cards.say: Today is Wednesday. What day is tomorrow? Thursday.

cards.front: Today is Wednesday. What day was yesterday?
cards.say: Today is Wednesday. What day was yesterday? Tuesday.

cards.front: Today is Friday. What is the day after tomorrow?
cards.back: Sunday. Tomorrow is Saturday, then Sunday.
cards.say: Today is Friday. What is the day after tomorrow? Sunday. Tomorrow is Saturday, then Sunday.

cards.front: How many months are in a year?
cards.say: How many months are in a year? Twelve months.

cards.front: Name the months of the year in order
cards.back: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.
cards.say: Name the months of the year in order. January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.

cards.front: Which month comes first in the year?
cards.say: Which month comes first in the year? January.

cards.front: Which month comes last in the year?
cards.say: Which month comes last in the year? December.

cards.front: Which month comes after March?
cards.say: Which month comes after March? April.

cards.front: Which month comes before July?
cards.say: Which month comes before July? June.

cards.front: Which month is between May and July?
cards.say: Which month is between May and July? June.

cards.front: Which month comes after November?
cards.say: Which month comes after November? December.

cards.front: What is the third month?
cards.back: March. January is 1st, February is 2nd, March is 3rd.
cards.say: What is the third month? March. January is first, February is second, March is third.

cards.front: What is the fifth month?
cards.say: What is the fifth month? May.

cards.front: What is the tenth month?
cards.say: What is the tenth month? October.

cards.front: Which month comes after December?
cards.back: January, the start of a new year.
cards.say: Which month comes after December? January, the start of a new year.

cards.front: Which is shorter: a day or a week?
cards.back: A day. A week is 7 days.
cards.say: Which is shorter: a day or a week? A day. A week is seven days.

cards.front: Which is longer: a week or a month?
cards.back: A month. A month is about 4 weeks long.
cards.say: Which is longer: a week or a month? A month. A month is about four weeks long.

cards.front: Which is longer: a month or a year?
cards.back: A year. A year has 12 months.
cards.say: Which is longer: a month or a year? A year. A year has twelve months.
